notes: Seed URL redirects to www.lamarcountytx.gov; its Elections page links 'Election Results' to results.enr.clarityelections.com/TX/Lamar/. Clarity elections.json lists all three elections (EIDs 122497, 126018, 126354). Classification uses election-day precinct votes: 2024 general had early-vote precinct numbers at 7:14 and 7:26 PM and election-day precinct votes in one update only (8:38 PM, the last version) = END. 2026 primary: election-day precinct votes in 3 night updates (7:49 PM, 7 precincts; 8:11 PM; 8:23 PM, 26 precincts) = LIVE. 2026 runoff: one night update (7:15 PM CDT, 5 precincts, the last election-night version) with election-day votes = END; an earlier 6:50 PM update had early votes. Several versions return 404 (2024: 8; primary: 3; runoff: 5), all before or between the readable ones, so an unreadable night update cannot be ruled out for 2024 (350800 between 10/18 and 7:14 PM) and runoff (372918 before 6:50 PM).
tag_rationale: 2024 general and 2026 runoff are END by check 1 (election-day precinct numbers in a single election-night update) and 2026 primary is LIVE; two END results give PRECINCT_END_OF_NIGHT, high confidence (check 1).
